title: transient-failures: run file patch rejected by scope enforcement requiring read+write fallback
description: patch_file on .moeb/runs/20260615T185944Z_fix_signal.json was rejected with scope enforcement error ('file has not been read during this run') even though it was written by the same run. The agent had to call read_file then write_file with complete content instead of a targeted patch.
proposed_resolution: Add an explicit instruction to the emittedSignals update steps in fix_signal.skill.md to call read_file on the run file before attempting patch_file, since scope enforcement requires a prior read regardless of who wrote the file.
